sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout returned 12 current-week candidates across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; Prismata was selected after URL, arXiv ID, and title checks found no duplicate in the latest clean data tree.

Main agent read the arXiv abstract and HTML paper, extracted the XSP threat model, action gate, Biba parsing, mechanical confinement, DOM corpus statistics, attack metrics, utility trade-off, and limitations.
Article uses pure Markdown with tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no images were localized because the key evidence is better represented as structured text.
